s: puM, (parisarvvatoBAvena tapyate'nena । pari + tap + vaY .) duHKam । (yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 8 । 52 । “sa tu janaparitApaM tatkftaM jAnatA te narahara upanItaH paYcatAM paYcaviMSa ॥”) narakAntaram । iti medinI ॥ SokaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 22 । 25 । “etayA tattvayA budDyA saMstaByAtmAnamAtmanA । vyAhate'pyaBizeke me paritApo na vidyate ॥”) Bayam । kampaH । iti viSvaH ॥ atyuzRatA ca ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 15 । 49 । “paritApaYca gAtreByaH pIqAbADASca kftsnaSaH । apahanti naravyAGra ! dayAM kuru mahIpate ! ॥”)
v: pu॰ paritapyate'tra pari + tapa--AGAre GaY । 1 narake karaRe GaY । 2 duHKe medi॰ । 3 Soke Sabdaca॰ 4 Baye 5 kampe viSvaH 6 atyuzRatAyAYca “te hrAdaparitApa PalAH puRyApuRyahetutvAt” pAta॰ sU॰ “te janmAyurBogA puRyahetukA suKaPalAH apuRyahetukAduHKaPalAH” BA॰ ।
m: परि-ताप m. glow, scorching, heat, Kālid.; MārkP.
pain, agony, grief, sorrow, R.; Kathās.; BhP. &c.
repentance, MBh.; Pañc.
N. of a partic. hell, L.
a: परितापः — 1 Extreme or scorching heat; (पादपः) शमयति परितापं छायया संश्रितानां Ś. 5. 7; गुरुपरितापानि गात्राणि 3. 18; Rs. 1. 22. --2 Pain, agony, anguish, grief; प्रसक्ते निर्वाणे हृदय परितापं वहसि किं M. 3. 1. --3 Lamentation, wailing; विरचितविविधविलापं सा परितापं चकारोच्चैः Gīt. 7. --4 Trembling, fear. --5 Hell.

m: परि-तापिन् mfn. burning hot, scorching, Kām.
causing pain or sorrow, tormenting, R.; Śiś.
परि-ताडिन् mfn. striking or hurting everywhere, Bālar.
परि-ताडिन् mfn. (√ ताड्) striking or hitting everywhere, Bālar.
परि-तारणीय mfn. (√ तॄ, Caus.) to be delivered or saved (?), Cat. (perhaps w.r. for -चारणीय = -चरणीय).
परि-तीर n. (prob.) = परि-कूल, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 182, Sch.

s: [s] vya, (pari + “paryyaBiByAYca .” 5 । 3 । 9 । iti tasil .) sarvvataH । caturddigaBivyAptO । ityamaraH । 3 । 4 । 13 ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 6 । 9 । “puropakaRWo pavanASrayARAM kalApinAmudDatanftyahetO । praDmAtaSaNKe parito digantAn tUryyasvane mUrcCati maNgalArTe ॥”)

m: परि-√ तंस् (only inf. of Caus. -तंसयध्यै), to stir up, RV.
परि-तकन n. (√ तक्) running round or about, L.

v: na॰ taka--hasane BAve manin । paritogamane tadarhati yat । paritakmya parito gantavye f॰ 1 । 3 1 । 67 BA॰ dfSyam । “parita enAM rAtriM takma” niruktoktAyAM rAtrO ca rAtreruBayata uzRatopalamBAt taTAtvam ।

m: परि-तक्म्या (आ), f. travelling, peregrination, ib.
(accord. to some also, ‘going round or overtaking an adversary's chariot’).
night (as the wandering, cf. x, 127), ib.
परि-तक्म्य mfn. wandering, unsteady, uncertain, dangerous, RV.
a: परितक्म्य — a. Ved. Dangerous, risky, unsafe. --क्म्या 1 Error. --2 Night, darkness.

m: परि-√ तम् P. -ताम्यति, to gasp for breath, be oppressed, Suśr.
परि-√ तन् P. Ā. -तनोति, ˚नुते (aor. -अतनत्; ind.p. -तत्य), to stretch round, embrace, surround, RV.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

परि-√ तप् P. -तपति (fut. -तपिष्यति, MBh.; -तप्स्यति, R.; ind.p. -तप्य, RV.), to burn all round, set on fire, kindle; to feel or suffer pain; (with तपस्) to undergo penance, practise austerities, RV. &c. &c.: Pass. -तप्यते (˚ति), to be purified (as by fire), Sarvad.; to feel or suffer pain, do penance, practise austerities, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -तापयति, to scorch, cause great pain, torment, R.; Pañc.; Hit.
a: परितप् — {c1c} P. 1 To heat, burn, consume. --2 To inflame, set on fire. --3 To suffer pain. --4 To practise penance. --Caus. 1 To scorch. --2 To torment.

m: परि-तप्त (परि-), mfn. surrounded with heat, heated, burnt, tormented, afflicted, RV.; &c.
a: परितप्त — p. p. 1 Heated, burnt. --2 Tormented, pained.

m: परि-तप्त-मुख mfn. having the face overwhelmed with grief, Bcar.
परि-तप्ति f. great pain or torture, anguish, L.
a: परितप्तिः — f. Excessive pain, anguish.

m: परि-√ तड् P. -ताडयति, to strike against, touch, Kathās.
परि-√ तर्ज् Caus. -तर्जयति, to threaten, menace, R.; Bhartṛ.
परि-√ तर्क् P. -तर्कयति, to think about, reflect, consider, MBh.; R.
a: परितर्क् — {c10c} P. 1 To reflect, consider. --2 To examine (judicially).

m: परि-तर्कण n. consideration, reflection, MBh.
a: परितर्कणं — Consideration, reflection.

m: परि-तर्कित mfn. thought about, expected (अ-परित्˚), Hariv.
examined (judicially), R.
परि-तर्पण mfn. satisfying, contenting, BhP.
परि-तर्पण n. the act of satisfying, Dhātup.
a restorative, Car.
a: परितर्पणं — Gratifying.

v: avya॰ pari + tasil । sarvatoBAve ityarTe । etadyoge sambanDArTe dvitIyA paritaH kfzRaM BaktAH ।
m: परि-तस् ind. (fr. परि) round about, all around, everywhere (न-परितः, by no means, not at all), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
as prep. (with acc., once with gen.) round about, round, throughout, AV.; &c.
a: परितस् — ind. (Usually with a noun in the acc., sometimes by itself) 1 All around, on all sides, round about, in all directions, everywhere, on every side; रक्षांसि वेदीं परितो निरास्थत् Bk. 1. 12; Śi. 5. 26, 9. 36; Ś. 4. 7; 3. 27; Ki. 1. 14; गाहितमखिलं गहनं परितो दृष्टाश्च विटपिनः सर्वे Bv. 1. 21, 29. --2 Towards, in the direction of; आपेदिरेंऽबरपथं परितः पतंगाः Bv. 1. 17; R. 9. 66.

k.v: समन्ततस्तु परितः सर्वतो विष्वगित्यपि। अकामानुमतौ काममसूयोपगमेऽस्तु च॥

m: परि-तत्नु mfn. embracing, surrounding, AV.
परि-√ तृद् P. -तृणत्ति (Impv. -तृन्धि), to pierce or thrust through, RV.; ŚBr.
परि-√ तृप् Caus. -तर्पयति, to satiate or satisfy completely, MBh.; R.
a: परितृप् — {c4c} P. To be pleased or contented. --Caus. 1 To satisfy, please, gratify. --2 To refresh.

m: परि-तृप्त mfn. completely satisfied or contented, Śaṃk.
परि-तृप्ति f. complete satisfaction, Up.
परि-तृषित mfn. (√ तृष्) anxiously longing for (comp.), Kāraṇḍ.
परि-तिक्त mfn. extremely bitter, जातकम्.
परि-तिक्त m. Melia Azedarach, L.

s: puM, (paritozaRamiti । pari + tuz + GaY .) sarvvatoBAvena tuzwiH । santozaH । yaTA, -- “tvAmudara ! sADumanye SAkErapi yadasi labDaparitozam । hatahfdayaM hyaDikADikavAYCASatadurBaraM na punaH ॥” iti SAntiSatake ॥
v: pu॰ pari + tuza--BAve GaY । saloze AtandaBede
m: परि-तोष m. (ifc. f(आ). ) = ˚तुष्टि
(with loc. or gen.) delight in Mn.; MBh. &c.
N. of a man, Cat.
a: परितोषः — 1 Contentment, absence of desire (opp. लोभ); सम इह परितोषो निर्विशेषो विशेषः Bh. 3. 50. --2 Complete satisfaction, gratification; आपरितोषाद्विदुषां न साधु मन्ये प्रयोगविज्ञानं Ś. 1. 2. --3 Pleasure, delight, delight in, liking for (with loc.); Ku. 6. 59; R. 11. 92; गुणिनि परितोषः &c.

m: परि-तोषण mfn. id., BhP.
परि-तोषण n. satisfaction, gratification, ib.
a: परितोषण — a. Satisfying, gratifying. --णं Satisfaction.

m: परि-तोषक mfn. satisfying, pleasing, Siṃhās.
परि-तोष—वत् mfn. satisfied, delighted, Kathās.
परि-तोषयितृ mfn. any one or anything that gratifies, pleasing, Śiś. (v.l. पर-त्˚).
परि-तोषिन् mfn. contented or delighted with (comp.), MBh.; Kathās.
परि-तोषित mfn. satisfied, gratified, delighted, Hariv.; R.; Kathās.

s: klI, (paritrAyate iti । pari + trE + lyuw .) mAraRodyatasya nivAraRam । tatparyyAyaH । paryyAptiH 2 hastavAraRam 3 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 5 ॥ rakzaRam । yaTA, -- “paritrARAya sADUnAM vinASAya ca duzkftAm । DarmmasaMsTApanArTAya samBavAmi yuge yuge ॥” iti SrIBagavadgItAyAm । 4 । 8 ॥
v: na॰ pari + trE--lyuw । 1 rakzaRe anizwe pravfttasya 2 nivAraRe ca “paritrARAya sADUnAm” gotA ।
m: परि-त्राण n. rescue, preservation, deliverance from (abl.), protection or means of protection, refuge, retreat, Mn.; MBh. &c.
self-defence, L.
the hair of the body, L.
moustaches, Gal.
a: परित्राणं — 1 Preservation, protection rescue, defence, deliverance; परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृतां Bg. 4. 8; रामापरित्राणविहस्तयोधं सेनानिवेशं तुमुलं चकार R. 5. 49. --2 Self-defence. --3 Abstaining from.

k.v: पर्याप्तिः स्यात्परित्राणं हस्तधारणमित्यपि। सेवनं सीवनं स्यूतिर्विदरः स्फुटनं भिदा॥

m: परि-त्रास m. (ifc. f(आ). ) terror, fright, fear, MBh.; Kāv.
a: परित्रासः — Fear, terror, fright.

m: परि-त्रात mfn. protected, saved, rescued, preserved, Kāv.; Pur.
परि-त्रात m. N. of a man, L.
परि-त्रातव्य mfn. to be protected or defended or saved from (abl.), Vikr.; Bālar.
परि-त्रातृ mfn. protecting, a protector or defender (with gen. or acc.), MBh.; R.; Pañc.

परि-√ त्रै P. Ā. -त्राति, or -त्रायते (Impv. -त्राहि, -त्रातु, -त्रायस्व; fut. -त्रास्यते; inf. -त्रातुम्), to rescue, save, protect, defend (-त्रायताम् or ˚यध्वम्, help! to the rescue!), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: परित्रै — {c1c} A. To rescue, save, protect; परित्रायस्व परित्रायस्व (in dramas),

m: परि-त्रस्त mfn. (√ त्रस्) terrified, frightened, much alarmed, Hariv.; R. &c.
a: परित्रस्त — a. Frightened, afraid.

m: परि-त्रिगर्तम् ind. round about or outside Tri-garta, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 11; 12, Sch.
परि-√ तुद् P. -तुदति, to trample down, pound, crush, MBh.

परि-√ तुष् P. -तुष्यति (˚ते, BhP.), to be quite satisfied with (gen. or loc. or instr.), to be much pleased or very glad, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -तोषयति, to satisfy completely, to appease, delight, flatter, ib.
a: परितुष् — {c4c} P. To be satisfied, be delighted or contented; अस्मत्कृते च परितुष्यति काचिदन्या Bh. 2. 2. --Caus. 1 To satisfy or please; completely. --2 To appease. --3 To flatter.

m: परि-तुष्˚टार्थ mfn. completely satisfied, Kathās.
परि-तुष्˚टात्मन् mfn. contented in mind, MW.

s: tri, (pari + tuz + ktaH .) paritozayuktaH । santuzwaH । yaTA, -- “yat prArTyate tvayA BUpa ! tvayA ca kulanandana ! । mattastat prApyatAM sarvvaM parituzwA dadAmi tat ॥” iti mArkaRqeye devImAhAtmye । 93 । 10 ॥
m: परि-तुष्ट mfn. completely satisfied, delighted, very glad, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: परितुष्ट — p. p. 1 Completely satisfied; वयमिह परितुष्टा बल्कलैस्त्वं च लक्ष्म्या Bh. 3. 50; so मनसि च परितुष्टे कोऽर्थवान् को दरिद्रः ibid. --2 Pleased, delighted.

m: परि-तुष्टि f. complete satisfaction, contentment, delight, Tattvas.
a: परितुष्टिः — f. 1 Contentment, complete satisfaction. --2 Delight, joy.

m: परि-तुष्य ind. being delighted or glad, Kathās.

s: puM, (parityajanamiti । pari + tyaj + GaY .) sarvvatoBAvena varjjanam । tatparyyAyaH । CoraRam 2 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ * ॥ “gurorapyavaliptasya kAryyAkAryyamajAnataH । utpaTapratipannasya parityAgo viDIyate ॥” iti matsyasUktam ॥
v: pu॰ pari + tyaja--BAve GaY । sarvato BAvena varjane
m: परि-त्याग m. (ifc. f(आ). ) the act of leaving, abandoning, deserting, quitting, giving up, neglecting, renouncing, Mn.; MBh. &c.
separation from (सकाशात्), R.
(pl.) liberality, a sacrifice, Hit.
N. of wk.
a: परित्यागः — 1 Leaving, quitting, abandonment, desertion, repudiation (as of a wife &c.); अपरित्यागमयाचतात्मनः R. 8. 12; कृतसीतापरित्यागः 15. 1. --2 Giving up, renouncing, discarding, renunciation, abdication &c.; स्वनामपरित्यागं करोमि Pt. 1. ‘I shall forego my name’; Ms. 2. 95. --3 Neglect, omission; मोहात्तस्य ( कर्मणः) परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः Bg. 18. 7. --4 Giving away, liberality. --5 Loss, privation. --6 A sacrifice. --7 Separation from.

m: परि-त्यागिन् mfn. leaving, quitting, forsaking, renouncing (mostly ifc.), MBh.; R.
परि-त्याजन n. causing to abandon or give up, MW.
परि-त्याज्य mfn. to be left or abandoned or deserted &c., MBh.
to be given up or renounced, ib.
to be omitted, Sāh.

परि-√ त्यज् P. -त्यजति (˚ते, R.; MārkP.; ind.p. -त्यज्य), to leave, quit, abandon, give up, reject, disregard, not heed, Mn.; MBh. &c.; (with देहम्) to forsake the body i.e. die, BhP.; (with प्राणान्, or जीवितम्) to resign the breath, give up the ghost, Mn.; MBh.; Daś.; Vet.; (with नावम्) to disembark, MW. : Pass. -त्यज्यते, to be deprived or bereft of (instr.), Mn.; Pañc.; Hit. &c.: Caus. -त्याजयति, to deprive or rob a person of (2 acc.), R.
परि-त्यज् mfn. id., MBh.
a: परित्यज् — {c1c} P. 1 To leave, quit, abandon. --2 To resign, give up, discard, renounce; प्रारब्धमुत्तमगुणा न परित्यजंति Mu. 2. 17. --3 To except; तृणमप्यपरित्यज्य सतृणं Sk. --4 To leave over, leave as a remainder. --5 To neglect, disregard. --Caus. To deprive a person of, rob any one of.

m: परि-त्यजन n. abandoning, giving away, distributing, W.
a: परित्यजनं — Abandoning, giving up, leaving.

m: परि-त्यज्य ind. having left or abandoned &c.
leaving a space, at a distance from (acc.), Var.
with the exception of, excepting, ib.
परि-त्यक्त mfn. left, quitted &c.
let go, let fly (as an arrow), W.
deprived of, wanting (instr. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
परि-त्यक्त n. anything to spare, Divyāv.
a: परित्यक्त — p. p. 1 Left, quitted, abandoned. --2 Deprived or bereft of (with instr.). --3 Let go, discharged (as an arrow). --4 Wanting.

m: परि-त्यक्तम् ind. without (comp.), Pañc.
परि-त्यक्तृ mfn. one who leaves or abandons, a forsaker, Mn.
